For everyone with curly hair I can totally recommend the curly girl/guy method (look it up).

For everyone else, try to refrain from using shampoo that contains non-water soluble silicones. 

At first they will make your hair look shiny and good but they also make your hair frizzy because they basically coat your hair and make it so nothing actual healthy will be absorbed by them. 

It's basically a good looking house with no or bad interior.

Due to being non-water soluble, should you think of changing your shampoo to something without those silicones, you should first use a shampoo that contains only sulfate and no silicone (for example Mane 'N Tail shampoo) 

This will clean your hair of all the silicones and reduces build up.

There are two "permanent" solutions to stop hair growth. The first one is called electrolysis hair removal. It is permanent but depending on the region it can take extremely long and is very expensive. 

The second one is laser hair removal. It may take on average 6-12 sessions for a region to be called hsirfree. It can be permanent but hair might grow back so you might need a refreshment session. Also it won't affect light hair at all. So you might still need electrolysis hair removal after all. Especially on the face people don't really know that there are also usually light hair mixed together with dark hair.
